# Chapter 12 · Moment Restrictions, Instrumental Variables, and GMM {.unnumbered}
*Endogeneity · Identification · 2SLS · Efficient Weighting · Overidentification*

일반적인 M- and Z-estimation의 일관성과 점근정규성 구조를 instrumental variables, two-stage least squares, 그리고 generalized method of moments에 적용한다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **12.1–12.4** endogeneity, IV moments, validity/relevance/rank, exactly identified IV
- **12.5–12.6** 2SLS projection geometry와 large-sample theory
- **12.7–12.10** GMM, sandwich variance, efficient weighting, $J$-test
- **12.11–12.13** weak instruments, causal interpretation, 요약과 연습문제
:::
